purpose: Teach: 真夜中/どっと/あげく/大金/居間/つぶやい/しつこい/うろうろ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、真夜中までゲームしてんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you're up gaming until midnight, aren't you?
lines.style: Light accusation with a knowing smile. Quick attack. Playful edge — she's caught him in something and is enjoying the moment. Relaxed, almost conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、終業のチャイムでどっと教室出たな、桜
lines.en: You bolted out of the classroom the second the bell rang, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry counter-accusation, half-amused. Flat delivery on the observation itself, then a slight warmth at her name. Not defensive — just turning her lens back on her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宿題やったあげく、忘れて来たろ?
lines.en: Riku, you actually did your homework and then left it at home anyway?
lines.style: Teasing lilt on the question. Faster pace, poking fun. A beat of mock disbelief in the middle. Warm underneath — she knows him well enough to find it funny.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お年玉で大金もらったろ?桜
lines.en: You got a huge wad of New Year's money, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Curious, testing. Slower on the setup, then lifts slightly at the question mark — like he's fishing for information. Not quite casual, not quite genuine interest either.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の家の居間、テレビでかいよな
lines.en: Riku, your living room has a pretty big TV, doesn't it?
lines.style: Light observation, borderline flattering. Steady pace. Slight lilt of approval. No real tension — just noticing something about him and letting him know she's noticed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト中つぶやいてたな、桜
lines.en: You were muttering to yourself during the test, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Caught-you tone, but gentle. Slight laugh underneath. Not accusatory — more like he's acknowledging something endearingly awkward she did. Intimate detail he picked up on.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、しつこいギャグはやめろよ
lines.en: Riku, drop the repetitive jokes already.
lines.style: Direct, but not harsh. Slight exasperation in the delivery. A tiny bit of actual irritation breaking through the banter, though not enough to sting. Calling him out without pulling back.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、駅前うろうろしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were hanging around the station the other day, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft curiosity, almost tentative. Slower pace. He's observed something and is gently raising it — not accusatory, but there's a layer of genuine interest underneath. Close attention, carefully voiced.
